Train B: leaves city B at 9:30, speed = 100 km/h

At time t (hours after 9:00):
- Train A has traveled 80t km from city A
- Train B has traveled 100(t - 0.5) km from city B (since it leaves at 9:30, which is 0.5 hours after 9:00)

They meet when the sum of distances equals 300 km:
80t + 100(t - 0.5) = 300
80t + 100t - 50 = 300
180t = 350
t = 350/180 = 35/18 ≈ 1.944 hours after 9:00

35/18 hours = 1 hour and (35/18 - 1)*60 = (17/18)*60 = 56.67 minutes

So they meet at approximately 10:56:40 (about 10:57).
